name: The Coffee Atelier
description: A stylish vegetarian specialty café serving Indian comfort food, artisanal coffee, fresh pastries, snacks, and indulgent desserts.

menu.name: Paneer Tikka
menu.description: Char-grilled cottage cheese marinated with yogurt, spices, onions, and bell peppers.

menu.name: Samosa
menu.description: Crispy golden pastry filled with spiced potatoes, peas, and aromatic Indian herbs.

menu.name: Aloo Tikki Chaat
menu.description: Crispy potato patties topped with yogurt, tangy chutneys, spices, and fresh coriander.

menu.name: Masala Dosa
menu.description: Crispy South Indian rice and lentil crepe filled with spiced potato masala, served with chutney and sambar.

menu.name: Paneer Butter Masala
menu.description: Soft cottage cheese cooked in a rich tomato, butter, cream, and cashew gravy.

menu.name: Veg Biryani
menu.description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with seasonal vegetables, saffron, herbs, and aromatic biryani spices.

menu.name: Chole Bhature
menu.description: Spiced chickpea curry served with fluffy deep-fried bhature and fresh onions.

menu.name: Dal Makhani
menu.description: Slow-cooked black lentils and kidney beans simmered with butter, cream, and traditional spices.

menu.name: Pav Bhaji
menu.description: Mumbai-style spiced vegetable mash served with buttery toasted pav and chopped onions.

menu.name: Masala Chai
menu.description: Traditional Indian tea brewed with milk, cardamom, ginger, cinnamon, and aromatic spices.

menu.name: Mango Lassi
menu.description: Creamy yogurt-based mango drink blended with ripe mangoes and a hint of cardamom.

menu.name: Iced Masala Latte
menu.description: Chilled espresso blended with creamy milk and a warm Indian spice infusion.

menu.name: Gulab Jamun
menu.description: Soft golden milk dumplings soaked in fragrant sugar syrup and served warm.

menu.name: Rasmalai
menu.description: Soft cottage cheese dumplings soaked in chilled saffron-cardamom milk.

menu.name: Gajar Ka Halwa
menu.description: Traditional Indian carrot dessert slow-cooked with milk, khoya, cardamom, and nuts.

menu.name: Chocolate Lava Cake
menu.description: Warm chocolate cake with a rich molten center served with vanilla ice cream.
